sloka: रक्षसा तेन रोषाच्च भुजानां पीडनात्तदा ।मुक्तो विरावः सहसा त्रैलोक्यं येन कम्पितम् ।। ७.१६.२९ ॥
transliteration: rakṣasā tena roṣācca bhujānāṁ pīḍanāttadā ।mukto virāvaḥ sahasā trailokyaṁ yena kampitam ।। 7.16.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, from the anger and the crushing of his arms, that demon suddenly let out a roar by which the three worlds were shaken.
